sentences.cn_text: 两年前,鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到「我们诸多机构中令人不安的诚信匮乏」。
sentences.en_text: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch’s daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the “unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions”.

sentences.cn_text: 她认为,诚信的崩塌源于社会集体接受了唯一的「筛选机制」应该是利润和市场。
sentences.en_text: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only “sorting mechanism” in society should be profit and the market.

sentences.cn_text: 但「是我们,是人类,是我们这些人创造我们想要的社会,而非利润」。
sentences.en_text: But “it’s us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit.”

sentences.cn_text: 为了阐明她的观点,她接着说:「越来越明显的是,政府、媒体或商界缺乏目标、缺乏道德语言,可能成为资本主义和自由最危险的目标之一」。
sentences.en_text: Driving her point home, she continued: “It’s increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom.”

sentences.cn_text: 她认为,同样的道德目标缺失正在损害新闻国际这样的公司,使其更有可能像在广泛非法电话窃听事件中那样迷失方向。
sentences.en_text: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.

sentences.cn_text: 随着窃听案审判结束——裁定《世界新闻报》前编辑安迪·库尔森共谋窃听电话罪名成立,而其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯同一指控不成立——更广泛的诚信缺失问题依然存在。
sentences.en_text: As the hacking trial concludes — finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge — the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.

sentences.cn_text: 已知记者曾窃听多达5500人的电话。
sentences.en_text: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.

sentences.cn_text: 这是工业规模的窃听行为,正如格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的,他是《世界新闻报》2001年雇佣的电话窃听事务负责人。
sentences.en_text: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.

sentences.cn_text: 其他人仍在等待审判。
sentences.en_text: Others await trial.

sentences.cn_text: 这一漫长的事件仍在持续展开。
sentences.en_text: This long story still unfolds.

sentences.cn_text: 在许多方面,道德目标的缺失不仅构成了如此广泛电话窃听的事实框架,还界定了审判进行的条件。
sentences.en_text: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.

sentences.cn_text: 令人震惊的揭露之一是,丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对其新闻编辑室所发生之事知之甚少,她几乎不曾想到要询问,也从未追问过这些报道是如何获得的。
sentences.en_text: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.

sentences.cn_text: 她成功辩护的核心在于她对此一无所知。
sentences.en_text: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.

sentences.cn_text: 在当今世界,高薪管理者无须为其所管理组织中发生的事情承担责任,已成为常态。
sentences.en_text: In today’s world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run.

sentences.cn_text: 或许我们不应如此惊讶。
sentences.en_text: Perhaps we should not be so surprised.

sentences.cn_text: 一代人以来,集体信条一直认为社会的筛选机制应该是利润。
sentences.en_text: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.

sentences.cn_text: 受到重视的词语是效率、灵活性、股东价值、商业友好、财富创造、销售、影响力,以及在报业中的发行量。
sentences.en_text: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.

sentences.cn_text: 被边缘化的词语则是正义、公平、宽容、相称性和问责制。
sentences.en_text: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.

sentences.cn_text: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的不是促进读者理解、秉持写作公正或展现任何共同人性。
sentences.en_text: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.

sentences.cn_text: 而是为了追求发行量和影响力不惜毁人前程。
sentences.en_text: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.

sentences.cn_text: 布鲁克斯女士或许对其记者如何获取报道存有疑虑,也或许没有,但她未曾提出任何问题,未曾给出任何指示——也未曾收到任何可追踪、有记录的答复。
sentences.en_text: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions — nor received traceable, recorded answers.

sentences.cn_text: 根据前两段,伊丽莎白对____感到不安
sentences.en_text: According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ____

sentences.cn_text: 当前筛选机制的后果
sentences.en_text: the consequences of the current sorting mechanism.

sentences.cn_text: 不道德行为导致的公司财务损失
sentences.en_text: companies’ financial loss due to immoral practices.

sentences.cn_text: 政府在道德问题上的无能
sentences.en_text: governmental ineffectiveness on moral issues.

sentences.cn_text: 机构间诚信的广泛滥用
sentences.en_text: the wide misuse of integrity among institutions.

sentences.cn_text: 从第三段可以推断出____
sentences.en_text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that ____

sentences.cn_text: 格伦·穆尔凯尔可能否认电话窃听是犯罪
sentences.en_text: Glenn Mulcaire may deny phone hacking as a crime.

sentences.cn_text: 更多记者可能被判定犯有电话窃听罪
sentences.en_text: more journalists may be found guilty of phone hacking.

sentences.cn_text: 安迪·库尔森应该被判该项指控无罪
sentences.en_text: Andy Coulson should be held innocent of the charge.

sentences.cn_text: 电话窃听在某些情况下将被接受
sentences.en_text: phone hacking will be accepted on certain occasions.

sentences.cn_text: 作者认为丽贝卡·布鲁克斯的辩护____
sentences.en_text: The author believes that Rebekah Brooks’s defence ____

sentences.cn_text: 暴露了狡诈的个性
sentences.en_text: revealed a cunning personality.

sentences.cn_text: 集中于琐碎问题
sentences.en_text: centered on trivial issues.

sentences.cn_text: 几乎毫无说服力
sentences.en_text: was hardly convincing.

sentences.cn_text: 是某个阴谋的一部分
sentences.en_text: was part of a conspiracy.

sentences.cn_text: 作者认为当前的集体信条显示出____
sentences.en_text: The author holds that the current collective doctrine shows ____

sentences.cn_text: 普遍扭曲的价值观
sentences.en_text: generally distorted values.

sentences.cn_text: 不公平的财富分配
sentences.en_text: unfair wealth distribution.

sentences.cn_text: 边缘化的生活方式
sentences.en_text: a marginalized lifestyle.

sentences.cn_text: 僵化的道德准则
sentences.en_text: a rigid moral code.

sentences.cn_text: 最后一段暗示了以下哪一项?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is suggested in the last paragraph?

sentences.cn_text: 写作质量是首要的
sentences.en_text: The quality of writings is of primary importance.

sentences.cn_text: 共同人性是新闻报道的核心
sentences.en_text: Common humanity is central to news reporting.

sentences.cn_text: 道德意识在编辑报纸时至关重要
sentences.en_text: Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper.

sentences.cn_text: 记者需要更严格的行业监管
sentences.en_text: Journalists need stricter industrial regulations.
